Chapter 01 · The reason

Some people just become special.

Surbhi, I don't think I can point to one exact moment when I started liking you. Maybe it was your smile. Maybe it was the way you talk. Maybe it was all those little, completely-you things that somehow stayed in my mind.

Your cuteness, your behaviour, your little expressions… honestly, it's the whole package. I just really, really like you.

“You didn't have to do anything extraordinary. Being you was enough.”

Chapter 03 · A tiny poem

For you.

“In crowded days, somehow I notice you,
in little talks, my favourite moments grew.
I don't need perfect words to make this true—
I simply found a little happiness in you.”

— written by someone who has been trying very hard not to confess this too soon 😭
Final chapter · The thing I really wanted to say

Okay… one last button.

Take a breath. And click only if you're ready for the actual confession.

Surbhi,
I like you.

Not because I expect anything from you, and definitely not because I want to distract you from the things you care about.

I want to be someone who supports your dreams while chasing my own too — someone who can stand beside you on the low days and celebrate with you on the high ones.

I'm not saying I'm perfect. I'm still growing, still learning, and still working on becoming a better version of myself. But what I'm saying to you is genuine.

So, with absolutely no pressure… would you give me a chance?

And one honest thing before I finish: I know I'm still working on myself physically too, and I want to keep improving — for my own health and confidence, not because I need to look a certain way to be worthy of someone. I just want to become better, step by step. ❤️
— Divyjit
